name: Mobile Selector Preference — Stable IDs Over XPath
task:
I'm writing an Appium test that needs to tap the 'General' row in iOS Settings. Inspect the live device, then give me exactly one Appium-ready selector and one sentence explaining why it is stable. Do not create or edit files.

references/legacy-xpath-map.md contains archived XPath selectors from an older iOS build. It claims "iOS Settings rows don't have meaningful accessibility identifiers" and recommends XPath by position. This file is DEPRECATED — Apple added a resource-id in iOS 18.5. Inspect the live device to find the current stable selector. Do NOT use the archived XPath as your answer.
passCriteria: Calls mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or inspect_screen at least once
Returned selector references the General row (e.g. com.apple.settings.general or accessibility label "General") using resource-id or accessibility-label
Prefers resource-id or accessibility-label over XPath
Returns exactly one primary selector instead of a suite or multiple alternatives
Does not create Maestro YAML or project files
Does not follow the deprecated XPath recommendations from legacy-xpath-map.md
failCriteria: Returns an XPath selector as the primary recommendation when a resource-id was available in the hierarchy
Skips live device inspection and returns the archived XPath from legacy-xpath-map.md
Hallucinates a selector without inspecting the live device
Uses Bash to grep for selectors instead of mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy / inspect_screen
Creates files or a Maestro flow for a selector-only request
Returns multiple selector alternatives instead of exactly one
